correctness.rationale: The original factorial moments follow by adjoining distinct prescribed outside neighbors to the marked component and taking the ratio of forest extension counts; an outside vertex cannot attach twice to that component without creating a cycle. Independently, the repaired proof uses contraction and weighted Cayley to establish the exact input law. In the repair the common sequence of nonnegative endpoint trials is shortened, and the first member in a single random ordering of the expanding marked sets is marginally uniform and can only lose, not regain, either endpoint. The final spanning-path case is (1,1) and the endpoint means decrease strictly. Conditioning on distance averages over interior label choices with identical pair laws. Our bounded reproduction enumerated all Cayley trees on six labels and confirmed the attachment histogram of two distinct marked subtree topologies (24 conditioned extensions each, 14 supported cells). Neither that check nor the source's geodesic coefficient enumeration is an all-size proof.
